title: Access hours vector
description: Access of a device right now from its effective rule access_hours and its access switch, in the hub time zone (DST included). tools/validate.py recomputes every case with tools/access_ref.py; hub and integration run the same vectors. A case may carry early (an early access); it opens the device outside its windows until early.until, followed by windows that start before it ends.

device_time_zone.description: Zone of the device clock for the app tests: an app runs the cases with this as its own zone and must get the same result, because the window edges follow time_zone (client_config.access.time_zone). The reference ignores it.

early.description: Running early access of the device (input); expected.early repeats it while until is after now.
